about: THE PLUGIN CORPUS: good and bad adventure plugins that the authoring tool (tools/test_adventure_plugin.py) and the game's own loader (tests/unit/test_plugin_corpus.gd) both judge; each must reach the verdict and the first reason written here. Every case is BUILT by the test: its base folder copied, its own folder laid over it, its edits, additions and removals made, its files hashed, then zipped when it says zip. The recipe's words are listed under recipe.

recipe.base: a folder of this corpus copied first (good_minimal: what adventure_plugin.py new writes)
recipe.folder: a folder of this corpus laid over the base, file by file
recipe.edit: {file: {set: [{path, value}], remove: [path]}}: a JSON file changed; a path is a list of keys and list indexes (an index one past the end appends); a value {$repeat: [text, n]} is text n times, {$list: [value, n]} a list of n values, {$nest: n} n lists nested in each other
recipe.add: files written: {rel, text} | {rel, hex} | {rel, repeat: [text, n]} | {rel, png: [width, height]} (a PNG header) | {rel, link: target} (a symbolic link) | {rel, dirs: 1} (an empty folder) | {rel, prefix_hex} (bytes put before the file's own); count: n makes n of them, {n} in rel numbering them
recipe.hash_files: true: plugin.json given a files list with the SHA-256 of every other file, as export writes it
recipe.after: changes once hashed: {rel, append: text} | {rel, delete: true} | an add
recipe.zip: {top}: the plugin zipped (stored entries) under that top folder, its files in the order of the folder's walk; extra: raw entries added {name | name_hex, text | hex, method, flags, made_by, external, size (claimed, the bytes not), count}; zip64: true writes zip64 end records; raw_text: the zip file is this text
recipe.reason: the first problem, exactly; {game_version} is the game's version
recipe.reason_prefix: the first problem begins so (the JSON parsers' own words differ)
